messages:
Nora: Quick sync on form validation + destructive confirms for console. Goal: standardize patterns across console: required marker, inline vs summary, confirm copy, keyboard/a11y. Thoughts?
Ibrahim: Strong +1 for one pattern. Required marker must not be color-only. Use visible asterisk + sr-only text and aria-required.
Clara: Inline on blur for immediate feedback. On input, clear error but don't revalidate until blur to avoid noise. On submit, show top summary with anchored list.
Mike: For destructive flows: tiered approach. Low risk = simple modal (bold warning + Cancel/Delete). High risk = type-to-confirm with exact-match and focus in the input.
Nora: Copy proposals: (1) "Type the resource name to confirm deletion:" (2) "Type DELETE to confirm. This action is permanent." Which fits infra better?
Ibrahim: Use resource-name for infra resources where identity matters. DELETE for generic/quick deletions. Always show what will be removed in the body.
Clara: A11y: make the dialog role="alertdialog" with aria-describedby for the warning, focus the input, and add role="alert" to inline error messages so screen readers announce them on blur.
Mike: Microcopy for summary header: prefer actionable phrasing: "Please fix the following fields to continue" vs vague. Also include "Jump to first error" link and focus that summary on submit.
Nora: Button behavior: keep primary CTA enabled (don't grey it out). On click, run validation and show summary if invalid. Disabled CTA often confuses people.
DesignBot: Figma mocks: https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/console-validation (updated) :thumbsup:
Ibrahim: Quick checklist I can PR for the DS: 1) Required marker pattern + sr-only 2) Inline on-blur + role="alert" 3) Submit summary with focus management 4) Tiered confirm modals + type-to-confirm templates 5) Microcopy examples and keyboard test cases.
Clara: I'll review the a11y snippets when PR is up.
Nora: Great, let's adopt these as the default for next sprint and add QA keyboard tests. Thanks team!
